=== Does pnpm 11 enable minimumReleaseAge by default? Check release notes via npm ===
has 11.x in registry
=== check pnpm changelog for minimumReleaseAge default ===

observation.command: cd /workspace/app && echo "=== Does pnpm 11 enable minimumReleaseAge by default? Check release notes via npm ==="; curl -sL --max-time 30 "https://registry.npmjs.org/pnpm" 2>/dev/null | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const v=j.versions['11.0.0']||j.versions['11.5.3'];console.log('has 11.x in registry');}catch(e){console.log('parse err')}})" 2>/dev/null; echo "=== check pnpm changelog for minimumReleaseAge default ==="; curl -sL --max-time 40 "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pnpm/pnpm/v11.5.3/CHANGELOG.md" 2>/dev/null | grep -iB2 -A6 "minimumReleaseAge\|release age" | head -40
